LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 4.1.1 LISTENING COMPREHENSION: SELECTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Selective Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Selective Listening, part of Strand 4 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to get the main points from an oral text? 2. How can you ensure you capture the relevant information from a speaker?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio text on consumer roles and responsibilities and decide whether the information presented is specific or general,

2. search online for audio recordings and attentively listen for specific information,

3. role play a scene on roles and responsibilities of consumers to emphasise listening skills during communication,

4. listen to a passage on consumer roles and responsibilities and answer questions posed by the speaker. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio text on consumer roles and responsibilities and decide whether the information presented is specific or general,
2. search online for audio recordings and attentively listen for specific information,
3. role play a scene on roles and responsibilities of consumers to emphasise listening skills during communication,
4. listen to a passage on consumer roles and responsibilities and answer questions posed by the speaker. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Listening Comprehension: Selective Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking: It is enhanced as the learner critically listens to oral texts and selects information.

Values:
Responsibility: It is enhanced as the learner listens to texts on consumer roles and responsibilities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Consumer literacy skills: They are enhanced as the learner listens to texts on consumer roles and responsibilities.

• Effective communication skills: They are enhanced as the learner listens to and responds to audio texts.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to practice selective listening as a lifelong skill and also relate it to the learning of listening skills in Creative

arts and sports.
